methodology.admission: All independent action-tree terminal nodes times (2*T+4), 20 logical slot units per call, plus 16 per branch and 64 fixed setup slots; full requested iterations are reserved before information rows or proxy/cache allocation; 30,000,000 cache slot ceiling.
methodology.archive_checks: Both 1k opt-in candidates must match pinned complete legacy payloads exactly; selected 3k must match its pinned full payload and normalized Fraction certificate exactly.
methodology.cache_scope: Per-solve LRU on private ranked-river branch kernels; only successful zero-fallback calls are cached. Original outer turn kernel and ordinary exact root-fold paths are retained.
methodology.default_mode: terminal_cache='none'; all legacy fields and complete-policy bytes must match opt-in after removing only terminal_cache metadata
methodology.limitations: Configured heads-up turn/river abstractions only. No general mutable-kernel cache, cross-river reuse, performance guarantee, memory/RSS claim, or unrestricted Hold'em claim.
methodology.logical_payload: At most 655,360 logical bytes for five numeric float slots per entry (two reach, two returned values, matched contribution); Python headers, key-container representation, references, LRU internals, temporaries and allocator overhead are excluded.
methodology.models: Two frozen matrix-free turn fixtures; selected/full CFR+ fixed sweeps; no convergence target or checkpoint callback.
methodology.preflight: Both fixtures receive exact 10-sweep default/opt-in complete-payload comparison and independent all-eight-metric replay.
methodology.runtime_accounting: Cache slot units bound only the declared logical validation/key/copy/LRU work model. They are not Python instruction, CPU, allocator, or RSS bounds.
methodology.runtime_research_gate: Predeclared reporting gate: median baseline/candidate ratio at least 1.10 in both fixtures. All misses remain in the report; this is not a promotion or default-change gate.
methodology.saved_profiles: Seven complete UTF-8 LF JSON payloads, each byte-hashed, reloaded, and independently replayed across eight metrics and physical counts.
methodology.timing: Three paired 300-sweep complete calls per fixture in baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate order. Construction, training, diagnostics, cache cleanup, and result serialization are inside each timer; independent replay and file/hash work are outside. Timings are uncontrolled observations.
